source_checks.finding: Page supports the Safety app steps: open the Safety app and sign in, select 'Your info', 'Emergency contacts', 'Add contact' and pick a contact already on the phone. Exact excerpt confirmed: 'To show your emergency information when your screen is locked, tap Emergency info access and then Show when locked.' The page also says the Personal Safety app is available on some Android devices and that some steps work only on Android 12 and up; the target's caveat about the app being on only some phones matches the page. The user's stated Android platform applies.
Page is for iPhone, so it does not apply to this Android user and is correctly unused in the target.

required_actions.action: Open the Safety app and sign in to your Google Account
Tap Emergency contacts, then Add contact, and choose the existing contact
Tap Emergency info access, then Show when locked

source_checks.finding: Page confirms the setup steps: Summary tab, profile picture, Medical ID, Edit or Add next to the field (step 5 says 'Tap Edit or Add next to the field you want to update'), 'You can add details such as Medications, Allergies, and any Conditions you have.', then Done. The page does not give an iOS version, and it is for iPhone, which matches the user. Show When Locked is not needed for the user's allergies-only limit, so skipping it is consistent with the request.

required_actions.action: Open the Health app and tap the Summary tab
Tap your profile picture, then tap Medical ID
Tap Edit or Add next to Allergies and enter the allergies

source_checks.finding: Page Applies To line lists Windows 11 and Windows 10. Exact excerpt confirmed: 'Change the size of the pointer by using the slide next to Size.' No version-specific steps, so it applies to the user's Windows 11 desktop.

Page Applies To line lists Windows 11 and Windows 10. The path 'Select the Start button, then select Settings > Accessibility > Mouse pointer & touch, and choose the options that work best for you' is confirmed. The page says 'Make your mouse more visible by changing the color and size of the mouse pointer', which supports the target's color sentence. The page names no specific color options, so the target correctly gives no color steps.

required_actions.action: Select Accessibility, then select Mouse pointer and touch
Use the slider next to Size to make the pointer bigger
Choose the pointer color options in the same section
